algorithm.title: Algorithm for the Management of Heart Failure.

cell.label: Suspected heart failure: Patient older than 60 years who presents with dyspnea, fatigue, or edema. Most will have a history of ischemic heart disease or hypertension or diabetes
ECG, BNP, and CXR (primarily to exclude other causes of dyspnea).
cell.path: Normal or not suggestive of HF

cell.label: Evaluate for other causes of symptoms.
Urine and electrolytes, creatinine, LFT, TFT, glucose, lipids, echocardiogram.
Assess for triggers, reversible causes, and underlying cardiovascular disease.
Use ACE inhibitor (or ARB) and β-blocker plus diuretic for symptoms.
If still symptomatic, consider spironolactone (if no renal failure or hyperkalaemia), digoxin (if in sinus rhythm), hydralazine, or isosorbide dinitrate.
Monitor weight, renal function, and electrolytes. Provide advice about smoking, alcohol, and monitoring symptoms. Give regular influenza and pneumococcal vaccinations.

footnotes.footnote: Abbreviations: ACE angiotensin-converting enzyme; ARB, angiotensin receptor blocker; BNP, B-type natriuretic peptide; LFT, liver function tests; TFT, thyroid function tests.
